newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Spain's Aznar to visit Argentina April 20-22.
newsitem.headline: Spain's Aznar to visit Argentina April 20-22.

text.p: Spanish Prime Minister Jose Maria Aznar will visit Argentina in April to promote a free trade deal between the European Union and South America's Mercosur trade bloc, an embassy official said Friday.
"The European Union-Mercosur issue will be very high on the agenda," the official said referring to the customs union formed by Argentina, Brazil, Uruguay and Paraguay.
Aznar will pay the official visit to Argentina April 20-22 after visiting Brazil, he said.
The EU and Mercosur hope to launch a free trade deal by 2005.
Aznar will also seek to boost political and trade ties with Argentina, which has Latin America's largest Spanish community.
The visitor will discuss with President Carlos Menem plans to hold a EU-Mercosur presidential summit next year.

The proposal was launched last week by French President Jacques Chirac during a south American tour. However, the embassy official said the idea was first proposed by Aznar at an Ibero-American summit in Chile last November.
